subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
6.  
Where the auditor relied on internally generated reports and oral explanations due to 
missing primary records, how is the reliability of audit evidence best evaluated? 
(a)  
Oral explanations are sufficient when supported by internal summaries 
(b)  
Internally generated reports are always reliable 
(c)  
Evidence is less reliable due to weak controls and reliance on oral representations 
(d)  
Copies and summaries are equivalent to original records 
 
5
